description: Replacing either endpoint by a mutually comparable element does not change whether a comparison holds.
signature:
AntisymmRel.le_congr.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} {a b c d : α} [Preorder α] (h₁ : AntisymmRel (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) a b)
  (h₂ : AntisymmRel (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) c d) : a ≤ c ↔ b ≤ d
